The '''Damask residence''' was a house on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], owned by [[Caar Damask]] and one of his [[Darth Plagueis's mother|wives]]. It had a lower courtyard connected to other parts of the house by at least one staircase. [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], who would be known as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Plagueis later in life, grew up here.
